title: Warak Enab with Smoky Feta
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish featuring stuffed grape leaves with smoky feta and a hint of yellow spices.
instructions: 1. Rinse the warak enab leaves and set aside.
2. In a bowl, mix together the smoky feta, yellow spice mix, and Middle Eastern seasoning.
3. Lay a warak enab leaf on a flat surface, with the stem end facing you.
4. Place a small amount of the feta mixture in the center of the leaf.
5. Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
6. Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
7. Serve the warak enab at room temperature, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
